content.text:
**Finding submitted: IP — missing (preferred cure).**

The Agreement has no IP or data ownership provision anywhere. HDI designs, develops, hosts and maintains the Site (§§1.1–1.3) and receives all our Content (§2.1) plus user information and data (§8.1), but nothing says who owns the Site, the deliverables or our data, and there is no licence back for HDI IP embedded in the Site. The only grant is the narrow trademark licence in §6.1, and §10.2's "co-ownership" wording addresses the parties' relationship, not IP.

Cure: one new Section 5.5 (inserted after §5.4) carrying exactly the nine preferred elements — Company ownership of the Site/deliverables with an assignment from HDI; HDI's retained pre-existing IP with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded HDI IP; Company retention of all rights in Company Data (defined broadly to reach all Content, user information and other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for us) with HDI's licence limited to processing solely to provide the services; and no joint ownership.
